For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: All convention lines use the prescribed format with no 'Not applicable' entries, e.g. task 1: 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §Endpoint registration: ... Inapplicable conventions (e.g. §Response types, §Caching in task 1) are omitted rather than annotated.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md Step 1: 'Priority | Major (set, so it is propagated)'; Step 6a additional_fields: '"priority": {"name": "Major"}' for Tasks 1-6, 'priority: the Feature priority is "Major" (not "Undefined"), so it is propagated.'

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md Step 6a: '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]' for every task; 'the Feature has RHTPA 1.5.0, and CLAUDE.md fixVersion scope: both includes tasks, so it is propagated.'

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md 'Jira comments written as files' claims 'summary-comment.md: plan summary, posted on TC-9001 (Step 6c)', but no summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory (only impact-map.md, impact-map-comment.md, task files and digest files). The impact map has no summary section (Step 6c); propagated values appear only in the Step 6a creation log's additional_fields block, not in a produced plan summary. The claimed artifact is missing, so this fails.
